claim: Physical parent actions are functionals on equivalence classes before matter/source variation.
formal_statement: Let pi: Conf_parent -> Conf_phys be the quotient by representative changes generated by v_q. The quotient action principle is S_parent = pi^* S_phys + dB_basic + S_constraint, with S_constraint first-class and boundary-silent on the local branch.
derivation: If two representatives are physically indistinguishable, the action phase/stationary equations cannot depend on the representative coordinate without making the representative observable. Therefore the physical action descends to Conf_phys; vertical variation is zero modulo first-class constraints and proper boundary terms.
what_it_proves: delta_vq S_parent=0 for physical bulk terms; nonbasic q_private source operators are illegal unless q_private is promoted to a physical scalar.
